distribution.labeled_sampling: fixed class counts; iid equal-probability minority modes, never redrawn
distribution.unlabeled_and_test_sampling: iid Bernoulli classes and iid equal-probability minority modes, never redrawn

primary_mechanism: budget minus count_matched descendant-weighted oracle expected endpoint error, among paired active runs
secondary_mechanisms: oracle expected error of all retained added minority training weight
eligible and usable endpoint counts; selected diversity and effective endpoint count
continuous exposure binding and loose-allocation infeasibility frequencies
minority-mode expected training mass and test recall
pairing: same case L/U/test/preprocessing/guide/candidate bank across methods; each cell reports ten paired dataset seeds
inactive: retain every case; lineage/child error null with zero descendants, never zero error; report reasons and denominators
restrictive: same log-utility continuous allocation with a loose exposure budget exceeds B by >1e-7*max(1,B)
mode_coverage: fraction of two minority modes receiving >=1 oracle expected minority unit of added training mass; U children and total added minority mass separate; also test per-mode recall
effects: budget minus each control; lower errors better, higher MCC/G-mean/AP better; mean, sample SD, SE, min/max and win/tie/loss (tolerance1e-10)
uncertainty: ten dataset seeds per cell; no fold-independence claim or confirmatory significance tests; pooled effects average within seed across all eight cells first
runtime: one thread, sequential cases; shared preparation plus incremental policy/final-fit/prediction times and total wall; shared cost is not standalone-method timing

decision_rule.promote: No automatic adaptive extension. Even favorable effects need new confirmation and literature review.
decision_rule.reject_current_advantage: If threshold_matched or weighted_pl matches or improves the primary error and MCC/G-mean/AP within the declared margins in every adequately active cell, reject the current claim of added value on this grid.
decision_rule.revise_or_inconclusive: If fewer than five paired active seeds per cell or endpoints lack risk/diversity, report under-identification; do not change eligibility, seeds or grid. Mixed effects warrant a revised mechanism hypothesis, not added complexity.
